#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    getline(cin, s);
    if (s.empty()) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    int count = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < s.length()) {
        char c = s[i];
        int start = i;
        while (i < s.length() && s[i] == c) {
            i++;
        }
        if (((i - start) & 1) == 0) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    cout << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
